text_block_list.text: Some time after the Arima Kinen had concluded—

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
"Congratulations on winning the
'Best Senior Umamusume' award!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text: She achieved tremendous success along the Senior Year royal road! And now, a few words from Fuji Kiseki-san—

text_block_list.name: Host
text_block_list.text:
Before that! Believe it or not, we have
a surprise guest joining us today~!

Along with the host's hype,
making a dashing entrance was—

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother
text_block_list.text: Hello, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Isn't that from that famous stage actor?! Ah,
right, isn't she Fuji Kiseki's mother?!

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother
text_block_list.text:
It's my daughter's big stage, so I thought maybe
I ought to watch over her from behind the scenes, but—

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! I truly never get tired
of seeing that surprised look on your face!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm surprised!
You usually stay behind the scenes at events like this.

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Don't worry, I won't get in your way.
There's just something I wanted to tell you. I'll make it quick!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"To tell you the truth—having me as your mother from such a young age
and admiring my back, I was worried about you."

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother
text_block_list.text:
You are not a copy of me.
Even if you walked the exact same path, I felt you would
never attain what you truly yearn for.

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother
text_block_list.text:
“Yet, brushing aside all those worries—
here you are, seeing your path through on your own two feet, having earned an irreplaceable sense of pride.”

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki, the pride you hold in your heart right now
is an irreplaceable treasure.

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Make sure you never lose it, okay?
Once again—congratulations, Fuji Kiseki.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
Thank you, Mom!

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother
text_block_list.text:
And Trainer, you too! Thank you for
supporting my daughter. I'm counting on you from here on out.

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother
text_block_list.text:
That's all, thank you for listening!
Now, let's pass it over to our star of the show!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“—And so, on top of being selected, thank
you so much for this wonderful surprise!”

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much for taking the time to come, Mom.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Just as Mother told me, over these past three years,
I have gained a strong and flexible pride.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Every bit of it is only possible
thanks to the support of the people I love.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
So this is just
a small token of my gratitude, but...

With those words,
Fuji Kiseki produced two bouquets out of seemingly nowhere.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"The blue tweedia is for you,
and the red geranium is... for Mother.
Thank you both, always!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Oops...!
Did you perhaps notice?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"No way! I just thought it'd be nice if I could give it to you.
I only prepared it just in case."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“—Or is that a bit of a stretch?
Fufu.”

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, to think you'd pull a reverse surprise on me.
You've grown so admirable before I even realized!

text_block_list.name: Fuji's Mother
text_block_list.text: "...Geraniums, huh? I see. That really braces my resolve. Thank you, Fuji."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That's my line.
...I'll be counting on you both from here on, too.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“—And so! Allow me to say once more,
thank you so very much for this award!”

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, this is not the end!
There are as many miracles left to fulfill as there are stars in the sky!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Look forward to—the next miracle!

Fuji Kiseki's award ceremony
drew to a close amid warm applause.
